official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, draw two cards. Then, by sending one core from any of your "Izanami" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, send up to two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Yomi Unleash] or [Yomi Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Yomi Unleash]", "give [Yomi Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
